messages:
morgan: Hey runtime team — small PR up that adjusts batcher backpressure and bumps per-key KV TTL. Can someone skim when free? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2893 Branch: fix/batcher-backpressure-ttl. Summary: if batcher queue > 200 we start shedding earlier to avoid OOM spikes; also extend KV per-key TTL 30s -> 60s to reduce cache churn on long-tail requests. Local perf + unit tests added.

ravi: @morgan quick q — does the TTL increase significantly change memory pressure under steady traffic? any numbers? :thinking:

morgan: Good call — ran load test with synthetic tail distribution. 95th miss rate down ~12%, 95th latency down ~8%. Memory usage up ~4% on p3-small snapshot. Put the full table in the PR description.

alex: I can take a look in ~30m. Any compatibility risk for Dedicated customers / private deploys?

morgan: No config schema changes. TTL change is server-side only and behind a feature flag `runtime.kv_extend_ttl` (off by default). Example opt-in in config:
```yaml
runtime:
  kv_extend_ttl: true
```
So customers won't see it unless they flip it.

sara: quick heads up — CI reported flaky failure in `batcher_unit_test` earlier, is that addressed in the branch? :eyes:

morgan: Yup — pushed a fix that uses a deterministic mock clock for that test. CI rerun shows green on my fork.

deploy-bot: CI build #2893 passed — all checks green. Merge requires 1 approval from core-runtime group.

ravi: PTAL in a bit. My main concern is potential race when queue transitions from overloaded -> drained at the same time TTL extension runs. Can you outline ordering guarantees?

morgan: Sure — ordering is: enqueue -> queue-size check -> if over threshold preview-shed -> if accepted, item goes to batcher; on flush we acquire per-key lock then read+write KV with TTL update as last step. TTL bump only touches entry metadata and is idempotent. I added comments and an assertion to ensure lock held during TTL write.

alex: left two tiny comments on var names & a docstring, nothing blocking.

sara: LGTM after CI. :thumbsup:

ravi: Approved. ✅

morgan: Thanks all. I'll merge during the 02:00 PST low-traffic window (in ~10m). If anything odd, ping @morgan and I'll roll back.

morgan: merged branch to main at 1747654741 — rolling deploy starting now. Monitoring dashboards set to alert on OOM/queue-growth.
